about: Reviewed facts about Bedrock's models that Bedrock's own lists do not give (src/providers/bedrock-catalog.ts). `names`: an AWS price-list model name and the Bedrock model ID it prices, for each name the matching rule (the same name or ID as ListFoundationModels gives, ignoring case) misses; each was checked against the usage types of that name's price rows, which carry the model ID or a close form of it. `noToolUse`: Bedrock model IDs, by prefix, whose live Converse call with one tool made no tool call or refused tools. Checked against the us-east-1 catalog and the price-list files in test/fixtures/; test/bedrock-catalog.test.ts fails when an entry no longer matches them.

noToolUse.evidence: Owner's account, us-east-1, 2026-11-26: google.gemma-3-4b-it answered the one-tool call with Python code and stopReason max_tokens, no toolUse block.
Owner's account, us-east-1, 2026-11-26: nvidia.nemotron-nano-9b-v2 answered the one-tool call with its thinking as plain text and stopReason max_tokens, no toolUse block.
Owner's account, us-east-1, 2026-11-26: us.deepseek.r1-v1:0 refused the one-tool call, ValidationException "This model doesn't support tool use."
